description: This file defines the internal class SiloStreamProviderRuntime, which implements the ISiloSideStreamProviderRuntime interface. It manages stream provider runtime functionalities such as initializing pulling agents, creating backoff providers, managing stream directory, and handling pub/sub mechanisms within the Orleans distributed framework.

classes.name: SiloStreamProviderRuntime
classes.description: An internal class managing stream provider runtime operations such as pub/sub, stream directory, and pulling agents within Orleans.

methods.name: InitializePullingAgents
methods.description: Initializes and returns a persistent stream pulling manager for a specified stream provider.

methods.name: CreateBackoffProviders
methods.description: Creates and returns backoff providers for message delivery and queue reading.

methods.name: CreateQueueBalancer
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a queue balancer for a given stream provider.

methods.name: ExecutingEntityIdentity
methods.description: Returns the identity of the current execution entity.

methods.name: GetStreamDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves the stream directory associated with the current activation or the hosted client.

methods.name: BindExtension
methods.description: Binds a new extension to the grain context, with checks for stateless workers.
